ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering the Extent of Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the extent of fraud in Minnesota, including the Feeding Our Future case and the Minnesota Somali Fraud case. It would examine the oversight and enforcement mechanisms in place to prevent fraud and identify areas for improvement.
questions: What is the total amount of money stolen through fraud in Minnesota?
What are the oversight and enforcement mechanisms in place to prevent fraud?
ideas.insight: I believe that this story has the potential to uncover a larger pattern of fraud in Minnesota and to identify areas for improvement in oversight and enforcement. By following the money and examining the mechanisms in place to prevent fraud, we may be able to identify systemic issues that need to be addressed.
